Sandbox_SuQingTrainingDummy_MeleeXP_tool: Base weapon skill XP earned each time a melee attack hits the dummy. Vanilla modifiers apply. Set to 0 to disable melee training XP.
Sandbox_SuQingTrainingDummy_EnableRanged: Off by default. When a gun fires, the mod checks for an unobstructed training dummy on the same level and resolves a training hit. Viewpoint and firearm mods need playtesting.
Sandbox_SuQingTrainingDummy_AimingXP: Base aiming XP per firearm hit
Sandbox_SuQingTrainingDummy_AimingXP_too: Applies when experimental firearm training is enabled. A shot awards XP once when it hits the dummy. Vanilla modifiers apply.
